Terms & Conditions

Please read these terms carefully before placing an order on AsbiMart. By accessing or purchasing from our platform, you agree to the guidelines below.

1 Product Authenticity & Natural Characteristics

All AsbiMart products—including raw wild honey, traditional cow & buffalo ghee, wood-pressed oils, dry fruits, spices, and organic superfoods—are sourced from natural origins without artificial preservatives or colors. Minor natural variations in color, aroma, or winter crystallization (such as natural mustard honey or pure ghee) are authentic signs of unprocessed purity.

2 Pricing, Discounts & Order Confirmation

  • All product prices are displayed in Bangladeshi Taka (৳ / BDT) and include standard packaging.
  • Promotional discounts and special offers apply while stocks last and may be updated without prior notice.
  • Please provide an accurate phone number and full shipping address so our team can verify and dispatch your order without delay.

3 Order Cancellation

You may cancel an order before it is handed over to our courier partner by calling our hotline at 01821-296056 or messaging us on WhatsApp. Once dispatched, standard Return & Refund Policy rules apply.

4 Delivery, Returns & Privacy

Shipping charges and timelines are governed by our Delivery Policy & Charges. Return eligibility and refund timelines follow our Return & Refund Policy, and personal information is handled under our Privacy Policy.
